Pattern gallery, page 2 of 8 (15-minute bars, MES / MNQ / MYM)

Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. EMA 8 red, 20 orange, 50 blue; VWAP light blue; dots = 3-bar swing points, diamonds = 10-bar swing points (only those already confirmed when the pattern appears). Momentum(14) below.

shooting star (bearish)

Rule: inverted-hammer shape after prior close > EMA10 -> bearish. 4,793 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

marubozu (bullish)

Rule: body >= 0.9 x range AND body > avgB10; direction of the body. 16,899 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

marubozu (bearish)

Rule: body >= 0.9 x range AND body > avgB10; direction of the body. 15,638 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

spinning top (neutral)

Rule: body <= 0.3 x range AND both shadows >= body AND range >= 0.5 x avgR10. 147,177 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

engulfing (bullish)

Rule: bar2 body engulfs bar1 body (opposite colours, at least one side strictly), body2 > avgB10, bar1 against the EMA10 trend; bullish after a down bar below EMA10, bearish mirror. 29,842 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

engulfing (bearish)

Rule: bar2 body engulfs bar1 body (opposite colours, at least one side strictly), body2 > avgB10, bar1 against the EMA10 trend; bullish after a down bar below EMA10, bearish mirror. 31,392 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
